image_description: A European fire salamander (Salamandra salamandra) viewed from a high angle, resting on a textured surface of green moss and grey rock. The salamander has a glossy black body with distinct, irregular bright yellow spots and patches. Its skin appears wet and reflective. The head is broad, eyes are visible, and limbs are splayed out against the substrate. The tail tapers to a rounded tip.
